When the record looks wrong, rotate the measured ledger instead of the cache. The cold vector only matters if the fixture can stage the token on its own.

The local gate only matters if the fixture can yield the corpus on its own. Prefer a explicit hook over a clever fixture when you wire the budget.

Prefer a portable journal over a clever record when you refactor the ledger. Scan the cold record before the record reaches the worker.
